basic_details.job_title: NLU Delhi Research Associate (Criminal Law) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National Law University Delhi (NLUD), Sector-14, Dwarka, New Delhi, is filling one full-time, contractual Research Associate (Criminal Law) post at Rs. 40,000 p.m. for a project on strengthening the Police services responses towards ending Violence against Women and Girls. The project is funded under the Research Endeavour Grant (N-REG) 2025-26 of the University, and the appointment is for 4 months maximum, ending by 15th March 2027. rows.details: Strengthening of the Police services responses towards ending Violence against Women and Girls
Research Endeavour Grant (N-REG) 2025-26 of National Law University Delhi
Data collection at Educational Institutions in various parts of Delhi

content_sections.heading: About NLU Delhi RESEARCH ASSOCIATE (CRIMINAL LAW)
content_sections.text: National Law University Delhi (NLUD) is a university at Sector-14, Dwarka, New Delhi. The post sits in a research project whose focus is suggesting best practices in light of the emerging global practices for police responses to violence against women and girls. The Project Director is Dr. Syed Iqbal Ahmad, Assistant Professor (Law), National Law University Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualifications, as printed in the notice: Law graduate (LL.B. or B.A.LL.B.) and LL.M. (appearing/completed) from a recognized Indian or Foreign University with a good academic record. At least one peer reviewed publication in quality journal. Knowledge of substantive and procedural criminal law. Proficiency in English. Skilled in MS Office applications. Desirable: previous experience in working on similar nature of research project/s/ data collection process. The age limit is not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is Rs. 40,000/- p.m. It will be funded out of the grants received from the N-REG project directly by National Law University Delhi. The nature of appointment is contractual, for 4 months maximum ending by 15th March 2027. The rules and regulations of National Law University Delhi shall be applicable to the selected candidate.

content_sections.heading: NLU Delhi RESEARCH ASSOCIATE (CRIMINAL LAW) Job Description
content_sections.text: Assist in the research work. Collect data from Educational Institutions in various parts of Delhi. The questionnaire and other necessary permissions/instructions shall be provided accordingly.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NLU Delhi RESEARCH ASSOCIATE (CRIMINAL LAW)
content_sections.text: Open the application form at careers.nludelhi.ac.in. Submit the application through the online form by 15 November 2026, 23:59. The notice states that physical/email applications will not be considered. Include all the attachments listed below. Incomplete applications will not be considered. Documents named in the notice: Résumé/CV, maximum two pages, including educational qualification, specialization, post qualification experience and publications. Copy of undergraduate degree and post graduate degree combined as one pdf file. Motivation statement (maximum 800 words) outlining how you fulfil the essential/desirable qualifications and also possess the skills required for this position. Any other document relevant to this application not already submitted above. The notice gives the email address [email protected] with the name of the Project Director, Dr. Syed Iqbal Ahmad.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be screened for completeness and relevance. Candidates are shortlisted based on an assessment of the application materials submitted through the online form. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview, which will be held online. Shortlisting does not guarantee an interview or selection, and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. The interview date is not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many Research Associate (Criminal Law) posts are there at NLU Delhi?
faq.answer: There is one post, as the notice says "Position: One".

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date is 15 November 2026, till 23:59 Hrs (11.59 PM).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: A law graduate (LL.B. or B.A.LL.B.) and LL.M. (appearing/completed) from a recognized Indian or Foreign University with a good academic record, plus at least one peer reviewed publication in a quality journal.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay for the post?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 40,000/- p.m., funded from the N-REG project grants received by National Law University Delhi.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Submit the online application form at careers.nludelhi.ac.in with the CV, degree copies, motivation statement and any other relevant document. The notice says physical/email applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q6. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Applications are screened for completeness and relevance, and shortlisted candidates are invited for an online interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, it is a full-time contractual appointment for 4 months maximum, ending by 15th March 2027.

faq.question: Q8. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview or interaction.

faq.question: Q9. Can a candidate whose LL.M. is still pending apply?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice accepts LL.M. (appearing/completed), together with a law degree (LL.B. or B.A.LL.B.).

faq.question: Q10. What will the Research Associate do?
faq.answer: The Research Associate will assist in the research work and collect data from Educational Institutions in various parts of Delhi.
